name: elenda_hexproof_from_instants_only
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Lifelink, hexproof from instants' (CR 702.11d: it can't be the target of instant spells an opponent controls). Support cards: FDN Scorching Dragonfire (verified instant: 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker) and Deathmark (mapped sorcery: destroy target green or white creature; Elenda is white and black). On seat 1's turn, seat 1's Scorching Dragonfire cannot target Elenda; seat 1's Deathmark, a sorcery, can, and destroys her.
